description: Check a site's sitemaps: discovers them from robots.txt, /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml, reads index files one level deep (20 children max), counts URLs per file and per host, summarises lastmod, and fetches a sample of URLs (HEAD, then GET) to count the ones that are not 200. Flags a missing sitemap, no robots.txt entry, over 50,000 URLs, other hosts, http URLs on https sites and missing lastmod.

sample.description: How many sitemap URLs to fetch, default 10, max 25 on free and 100 on Pro

name: check_sitemap
